# Temiloluwa Akintade

> Software developer with 5+ years of experience building web applications, blockchain products, smart contracts, systems software, and embedded tools.

## Featured Projects

- [ShipTok](https://shiptok-app.vercel.app): Social discovery platform for makers and builders to share builds, explore trending projects, and connect with creators. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Tailwind CSS.
- [Ohm-E](https://github.com/Temi-Tade/Ohm-E): Interactive browser-based circuit simulator with a component library, real-time current flow, voltage coloring, and oscilloscope. Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- [RivETH](https://temi-tade.github.io/RivETHDocs) ([GitHub](https://github.com/Temi-Tade/RivETH)): Open-source Ethereum smart contract infrastructure for deploying and interacting with smart contracts (Alchemy-listed). Stack: JavaScript, Node.js, Hardhat.
- [qodon](https://github.com/Temi-Tade/qodon): CLI-based genomics and bioinformatics tool written in C.
- [Medusa](https://temi-tade.github.io/medusa) ([GitHub](https://github.com/Temi-Tade/medusa)): Client-side password-based file encryption tool with lossless decryption. Stack: JavaScript.
- [Skaylar](https://temi-tade.github.io/Skaylar) ([GitHub](https://github.com/Temi-Tade/Skaylar)): Tool for analyzing and visualizing first-digit distributions using Benford's Law. Stack: JavaScript.
